content: On reception of the UDS Service DynamicallyDefineDataIden- tifier (0x2C), the Dcm module shall check if the requested Source-DID or the mem- oryRange are supported in the current security level (see configuration parameter of referenced DID DcmDspDidReadSecurityLevelRef or memoryRange DcmD- spReadMemoryRangeSecurityLevelRef). If not, the Dcm module shall send a NRC 0x33 (Security access denied).
